constant_columns.treatment_protocol_ch1: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were isolated from EDTA-treated blood using OptiPrep® Density Gradient Medium (SIGMA). Monocytes were isolated from PBMC using a negative magnetic cell separation methods (Miltenyi Biotec Monocyte Isolation Kit II Human and the autoMACS® Pro Separator). constant_columns.extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA for transcriptome analysis was extracted from isolated monocytes using TRIzol® (Gibco BRL Life Technologies, Rockville, MD). RNA was purified using Qiagen-RNeasy Mini Kit. RNA pellets were resuspended in diethyl pyrocarbonate-treated water. RNA integrity was assessed (prior to beginning target processing) using Agilent Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent Technologies, Inc., Palo Alto, CA, USA)....
constant_columns.data_processing: The quality of the sequencing was first assessed using the fastQC tool (v0.11.9).
